description: 发现盗刷、重复扣款或被冻结时，快速冻结卡片、提出争议、问清调查时间和临时额度。

targetChunks.en: There's an unauthorized charge on my account.
targetChunks.zh: 我账户有一笔未经授权的扣款。
targetChunks.note: unauthorized charge = 盗刷/未授权扣款，银行标准词。
targetChunks.exampleEn: There's an unauthorized charge on my account.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我账户有一笔未经授权的扣款。

targetChunks.note: 直接否认交易；配合金额和日期。

targetChunks.en: I'd like to dispute this charge.
targetChunks.zh: 我想对这笔扣款提出争议。
targetChunks.note: dispute a charge = 正式提出争议，比 complain 准确。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'd like to dispute this charge.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我想对这笔扣款提出争议。

targetChunks.note: freeze a card = 冻结卡片，防止继续被盗刷。

targetChunks.en: How long will the investigation take?
targetChunks.note: investigation 是银行对争议交易的标准流程。
targetChunks.exampleEn: How long will the investigation take?

targetChunks.en: Will I get a temporary credit?
targetChunks.zh: 会给我临时信用额度吗？
targetChunks.note: temporary/provisional credit = 临时垫付，争议期间很关键。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Will I get a temporary credit while you investigate?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 调查期间会给我临时垫付吗？

targetChunks.en: I was charged twice for the same transaction.
targetChunks.zh: 同一笔交易被扣了两次。
targetChunks.note: charged twice = 重复扣款；比 you took my money twice 专业。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I was charged twice for the same transaction.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 同一笔交易被扣了两次。

targetChunks.en: Can you send me a statement?
targetChunks.note: statement = 银行对账单；留证据。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can you send me a statement for last month?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 能给我发上个月的对账单吗？

targetChunks.en: What do I need to provide?
targetChunks.note: 问材料清单，避免反复补件。
targetChunks.exampleEn: What do I need to provide for the dispute?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 提出争议需要我提供什么？

targetChunks.en: Could you escalate this to the fraud team?
targetChunks.zh: 能升级给反欺诈团队吗？
targetChunks.note: fraud team = 反欺诈部门；普通客服处理不了时用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Could you escalate this to the fraud team?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 能升级给反欺诈团队吗？

targetChunks.note: keep me posted = 持续同步；比 tell me later 礼貌。

roleplay.promptZh: 你发现账户有一笔两百美元的盗刷。打电话给银行：否认交易、冻结卡片、提出争议，问清临时额度和调查时间。
roleplay.promptEn: Call the bank about a $200 unauthorized charge. Deny the transaction, freeze the card, dispute the charge, and ask about provisional credit and timing.
goals: 说清金额、日期和未授权
要求冻结卡片并正式争议
问清临时额度和调查周期

script.speaker: you
script.en: There's an unauthorized charge on my account.
script.zh: 我账户有一笔未经授权的扣款。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Can you tell me the amount and date?
script.zh: 能告诉我金额和日期吗？

script.speaker: you
script.en: Two hundred dollars on Tuesday. I didn't make this purchase.
script.zh: 周二，两百美元。这笔消费不是我做的。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Please do. I'd like to dispute this charge.
script.zh: 请冻结。我想对这笔扣款提出争议。

script.speaker: you
script.en: How long will the investigation take? Will I get a temporary credit?
script.zh: 调查要多久？会给我临时垫付吗？

script.speaker: other
script.en: Up to ten business days, and yes, a provisional credit.
script.zh: 最多十个工作日，会有一笔临时垫付。

script.speaker: you
script.en: What do I need to provide? Could you escalate this to the fraud team?
script.zh: 我需要提供什么？能升级给反欺诈团队吗？

script.speaker: other
script.en: I'll send you a form and flag it for fraud.
script.zh: 我会发你一份表，并标记给反欺诈。
